high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram Explore page, featuring a post by the account "didyoucatchthistv." The post shows a muscular individual dressed as Wolverine, a character from the X-Men franchise. The person is shirtless, revealing a well-defined physique with some visible injuries or blood on their chest and arm, which adds to the dramatic effect of the costume. The individual is wearing yellow and blue pants that resemble Wolverine's iconic costume, complete with claws extended from their hands. The post has garnered 8,326 likes and was shared 3 days ago.
